FEAT327-ACQ-04 — controlling external-credential addendum

KEEP all four existing operative feat procedures. No new class rage, lineage, class, deity, plane or exposure event is needed to finish these acquisition specifications. Adopt the narrowly scoped evidence contract below as NEW, distinguishing a conditional test result from an established character credential.

I verified the supplied ZIP against its actual root PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json: 27 payloads match; 101 read-only source/binding checks passed. I compared the four complete contracts with their bound copies, examined the relevant grants across the 17 class payloads, and checked the current class/ancestry identities, shared rules, Berserker parent and separate CF-03 procedure. These checks did not rerun ACQ-03’s suites, execute feat behavior or authenticate campaign history.

The package contains the complete addendum, exact derived operations, evidence contract, bound source extracts, reproducible source checker and sixteen finite acceptance groups:

Download the addendum and evidence package


Complete controlling addendum
 · 
Machine-readable credential policy

Package SHA-256: 6b8b40aa97338f2eab9e9214184991e4f4428f24495a07ca3d930c48c145a49a

ACQ04-01 — Frenzied Rage: KEEP

No supplied operative class card establishes its class-rage acquisition branch. The complete source scan also identified several neighboring descriptions that must not be treated as rage grants:

Current source location	Actual disposition
druid.json /cards/27 — druid.hero.moon.mooncursed	Its operative effect grants the stated bite/full-moon benefit, not a rage state. Preserve historical “Lunar Rage.”
druid.json /cards/4 — druid.base.bear-form-tank	Its operative form/claw benefits are not a rage grant. Preserve historical “Rage-like trait.”
warrior.json /cards/71 — warrior.supplement.berserker-brew	A serum profile, not a class rage ability.
paladin.json /cards/35 — paladin.supplement.oath-of-vengeance.vengeful-smite	“Rage” occurs in conduct prose, not an operative state grant.
cleric.json /cards/56 — cleric.hero.cultist.zealot-s-fervor	A specified stance/buff; historical religious frenzy does not establish rage.
crimson-agent.json /cards/42 — crimson-agent.hero.thirstborn.blood-frenzy	A damage benefit tied to hostile Bleeds, not rage.
crimson-agent.json /cards/48 — crimson-agent.hero.thirstborn.veinweave-blood-frenzy	Its distinct Veinweave state is not expressly a rage state.

These files are under DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/data/public/class_playtests/. Their complete selected objects and hashes are preserved in the evidence package.

Exact acquisition disposition:

KEEP the complete Frenzied Rage procedure and CON15 AND (owned berserker OR actual acquired class rage ability). No operative card in the supplied seventeen class payloads expressly grants a qualifying class rage state. Preserve the class alternative as an external source-qualified branch; do not delete it, hard-code it permanently false, or create a class feature to populate it. The actual, separately paid berserker feat satisfies the parent alternative when its own acquisition was lawful. Frenzied Rage still requires CON15 and its own lawful feat opportunity. The distinct berserker_rage/CF-03 is an operating rage only after Frenzied Rage was otherwise acquired lawfully; it is neither the named berserker parent nor a class-rage credential. No rage must be active merely to prove the required ownership at acquisition. All use-time rage requirements remain unchanged.

This is retained interpretation of the existing complete procedure, not a new rage mechanic.

For example, an otherwise-lawful Warrior with CON15 can spend the actual Warrior-4 opportunity on Berserker and the separate Warrior-8 opportunity on Frenzied Rage. The supplied foundation lists those opportunities. That is a conditional prerequisite example, not a claim that a character completed that history or a certification of their entire build.

Affected contract: FEAT_EXACT_01_ACQUISITION_CONTRACTS.json /records/310. Keep the existing requirement tree and completeOperativeProcedure unchanged.

ACQ04-02 — Divine Favor and Elemental Body: KEEP; complete the evidence interface

Yes: pre-push specification can be completed using explicitly conditional, opaque test-world fixtures and guarded rejection of unsupported actual acquisitions. It does not require inventing cosmology or producing a real campaign positive example.

Divine Favor

KEEP CHA15 and actual already-established worship of a deity. Evidence must establish that this character’s worship relationship to an already-established opaque deity reference qualifies at the acquisition snapshot. A class, ancestry, background label, description of favor, deity name or worship:true assertion does not independently prove that relationship. Do not add a separate favor award, doctrine, minimum observance period, religious test, ritual, fee or new deity choice. An explicitly conditional fixture exercises the literal predicate only within its test world; it establishes no actual campaign worship history. The complete operating procedure remains unchanged.

“Worship a deity” is the prerequisite. The description about having earned favor does not become an additional independently required favor-grant receipt.

Affected contract: /records/92.

Elemental Body

KEEP CON15 and an actual recorded event satisfying exposure to an elemental plane before acquisition. Evidence must connect the exposed character, world, event, already-established opaque plane reference and literal qualifying predicate under the relevant record authority. Elemental damage, resistance, a Drakari variant, a class spell or a generic visit does not by itself establish that event. Do not invent a plane, exposure duration or intensity, causal infusion test, or element-to-plane matching requirement. Retain the already-adopted permanent choice of acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder, recorded separately from exposure evidence. A conditional fixture exercises only the predicate interface and supplies no campaign event. The complete operating procedure remains unchanged.

This remains a prior-event prerequisite, not a requirement to remain exposed or present in that location when selecting the feat.

Affected contract: /records/104.

NEW minimal evidence contract — ACQ04-EC1

Existing records may be referenced rather than duplicated. The following fields define the necessary information; they are not a new manual bookkeeping gate.

Field	Required meaning
evidenceMode	Explicitly conditional_fixture or campaign_record. A fixture cannot silently become campaign evidence.
worldId, characterId	Stable identities matching the acquisition, supporting records and authority scope. Nonempty strings alone prove nothing.
acquisitionRef	A bound acquisition snapshot containing the exact feat, actor/world, authoritative time and sequence, applicable permanent statistics/ownership, required choices and independently payable opportunity. Evaluating eligibility does not spend the opportunity.
predicate	Exact featId, selected branch and contractRef to the controlling prerequisite/procedure. Preserve its actual AND/OR structure.
credentialRefs	Bound supporting grant, state or event records, including their subject, source clause and establishment/occurrence order. Their contents, not merely their existence, must support the predicate.
authorityRef	The existing world/character record authority and its actual scope to establish or admit that fact. An unchecked authorized:true is insufficient. This adds no new owner confirmation, witness requirement or authentication service.
choiceBindings	Required only where applicable: Elemental Body’s actual permanent menu choice; Dragon Blood’s one damage type bound to the same qualifying lineage/bloodline source. No invented choices for the other two feats.

A bound reference resolves immutable source bytes and the exact record or field using path, sha256 and pointer, or an equivalent losslessly bound existing versioned-record reference. A text source needs an exact section locator. A matching hash authenticates the cited bytes, not the character’s history or the issuer’s authority.

The supporting grant, qualifying worship state or exposure event must precede acquisition in authoritative order. Equal timestamps may qualify when a genuine earlier sequence establishes precedence; no arbitrary extra elapsed-time delay is required. Later assertions cannot manufacture an earlier event. Legitimate corrections retain their predecessors and authority.

Use these distinct outcomes:

Result	Meaning
CONDITIONAL_ONLY	The predicate holds under the explicitly declared fixture premises. It is not a campaign credential or acquisition.
UNESTABLISHED	Required evidence is missing, unbound, mismatched or insufficient. The predicate does not qualify; this does not assert that the event never happened.
CONTRADICTED	Resolved evidence affirmatively fails the predicate, such as offering actual Mage membership as literal Sorcerer membership.
ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT	Independently admitted actual-world evidence establishes that external predicate at that snapshot. This review supplies or authenticates no such positive campaign record. Other acquisition gates remain separate.

A passing fixture may therefore demonstrate that the interface is complete without opening current content or pretending an external source was supplied.

ACQ04-03 — Dragon Blood: KEEP

The current foundation’s seventeen class options and the ancestry catalog’s fourteen lineages/forty-five variants do not provide literal Dragonborn or a Sorcerer class. Drakari’s draconic traits do not alter that identity; the feat-only Sorcerer curriculum expressly does not grant the class. This retains FS-02’s established non-alias rule rather than adding a new prohibition. 
Pasted text

Exact disposition:

KEEP (actual Dragonborn lineage OR actual Sorcerer class with draconic bloodline) AND one recorded draconic ancestry damage type from that same qualifying source, together with the independently paid opportunity and all other actual gates. Drakari, Mage, a feat-only Sorcerer curriculum, Draconic literacy, a dragon-like name or an unbound class-level label supplies no alias or lineage grant. Preserve both alternatives and the full feat, but actors lacking the exact admissible external lineage or class-and-bloodline source remain ineligible. A clearly isolated conditional imported-legacy fixture may exercise either branch, including its source-bound damage type, without adding a selectable lineage/class, authenticating a campaign history or changing any current flag. The complete operating procedure and reviewed language interaction remain unchanged.

For the Sorcerer branch, the existing normalized contract requires actual Sorcerer class level at least 1 plus the actual draconic-bloodline credential. Neither an arbitrary Sorcerer:1 field nor bloodline prose without the class establishes that conjunction.

The missing positive source is precisely one of these:

An admitted Dragonborn lineage source assigning that lineage to the character and establishing its one relevant damage type.
An admitted Sorcerer class source and character assignment, plus the character’s draconic-bloodline grant and its one relevant damage type.

Those remain particular-character prerequisites, not missing procedures that prevent completing this guarded specification. Do not substitute a free damage-type choice or borrow the type from another character or lineage.

Affected contract: /records/94. Keep the full requirement tree and operating procedure unchanged.

ACQ04-04 — exact additions and finite closure
Exact shared wording to append to FS-02

Append this after the existing FS-02 wording; do not replace its acquisition, weapon, training or ACQ-03 casting provisions:

External-credential evidence — FEAT327-ACQ-04. NEW evidence-contract completion; the four existing feat procedures and their prerequisite alternatives are retained. For frenzied_rage, divine_favor, elemental_body and dragon_blood, evaluate a required external credential under ACQ04-EC1 against the same character, world and ordered acquisition snapshot, using the exact operative prerequisite and source version, linked credential or event evidence, and that world’s established authority for recording that fact. A source file establishes wording, not that a particular character acquired a feature, worships a deity, experienced an event or possesses a lineage. A name, nonempty story label, unchecked Boolean, prospective feat benefit or unrelated class/ancestry/item grant supplies no credential. The supporting grant, worship state or exposure event must already qualify before acquisition; same-time events require an authoritative earlier sequence. Worship must be established at that snapshot; exposure is a qualifying prior event, not a requirement to remain exposed. Apply the branch-specific facts and required choices in ACQ04-EC1 without adding doctrine, an exposure threshold, an element-to-plane matching rule or a legacy alias. A conditional, opaque test-world fixture can establish only a CONDITIONAL_ONLY predicate result within that fixture. It supplies no actual campaign history, selectable option, class feature, cosmology approval or entitlement. Missing, unbound, mismatched or insufficient evidence leaves a predicate UNESTABLISHED; affirmative incompatible evidence is CONTRADICTED. Neither result satisfies a required AND node, although a separately satisfied printed OR alternative remains valid. An ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT result requires independently admitted actual-world evidence and is not supplied by this review. Preserve all original source fields, absence/null distinctions, acquisition history and current status/selection flags. All other permanent-ability, level, parent-feat, mandatory-choice and earned-opportunity predicates remain independently required; one paid opportunity cannot fund two acquisitions. Later use still requires the exact feat’s ongoing predicates. This evidence policy does not reopen ACQ-03 or change its casting-snapshot rules.

The packaged operation contains the authoritative plain-text string, avoiding copying differences from rendered Markdown.

Minimal derived locations
Location	Authorized addition
DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/data/public/feat_candidates/exact_01/shared_rules.json — /rules/1/wording, guarded by id == FS-02	Append the exact shared paragraph.
Corresponding internal shared_rules.json and docs/feats/exact-candidate-01/SHARED_RULES.md — FS-02	Mirror the same addition. These paths are named in the supplied ACQ-03 receipt but their full current files are not in this narrow ZIP; no current equality or descendant hash is claimed here.
docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/FEAT327_ACQ_04_EXTERNAL_CREDENTIAL_POLICY.json	Add the packaged policy containing ACQ04-EC1 and the four dispositions.
FEAT_EXACT_01_ACQUISITION_CONTRACTS.json — /records/310, /records/92, /records/104, /records/94	Add only externalCredentialPolicyRef, pointing to the matching policy disposition. Preserve every existing record field.
Existing derived acquisition manuscript, where it renders those policy references	Render the four reference additions, not replacement prerequisites or procedures.

The JSON operations provide exact reference values and identity guards. No replacement of the four completeOperativeProcedure strings is necessary.

Finite acceptance expectations

These are authored expectations for local fulfillment, not behavioral tests I executed:

Case	Required outcome
T01 — Seven current class candidates above	None establishes the class-rage branch; historical descriptions remain preserved.
T02 — Lawfully paid Berserker parent, CON15 and a separate Frenzied Rage opportunity	Parent alternative qualifies without requiring an active rage at acquisition.
T03 — Only CF-03 or Frenzied Rage’s prospective benefit	Acquisition fails. CF-03’s separately permitted later operating interaction remains intact.
T04 — Isolated conditional external class-rage source plus source-qualified actor assignment	CONDITIONAL_ONLY exercises the preserved class branch. Source text without actor assignment is insufficient. No class is added.
T05 — Bound opaque worship fixture, qualifying relationship at acquisition, CHA15 and separate opportunity	Conditional predicate succeeds only in that fixture.
T06 — Deity/source exists but no worship relationship; or relationship ended beforehand	Respectively UNESTABLISHED or CONTRADICTED; no additional favor/ritual gate is invented.
T07 — Bound prior exposure fixture and one existing permitted type choice	Conditional predicate succeeds; no ongoing exposure or plane/type match is required.
T08 — Elemental damage, resistance, name or generic visit alone	Exposure remains unestablished.
T09 — Valid external premise but failed ability or payment gate	Acquisition still fails.
T10 — Absent/null/unresolved reference, wrong hash/version/pointer, actor/world mismatch or missing authority scope	Credential remains unestablished, preserving distinct failure reasons and raw field states.
T11 — Later event, ambiguous same-time order, or genuinely earlier sequence	Later/ambiguous evidence cannot qualify; the actual earlier sequence may satisfy chronology.
T12 — Drakari, Mage, curriculum, literacy or unbound Sorcerer label offered for Dragon Blood	No false alias qualifies.
T13 — Conditional legacy Dragonborn assignment and linked damage type	Conditional-only success; missing or mismatched source/type fails.
T14 — Conditional legacy Sorcerer class assignment, bloodline and linked type	Conditional-only success; missing class, bloodline or matching type fails its actual conjunction.
T15 — Fixture relabeled or mixed into campaign evidence	Reject as an actual credential; never collapse conditional provenance into an unqualified eligible:true.
T16 — Apply additions and compare preservation/parity	All existing procedures, prerequisite trees, originals, other contracts, class/ancestry/supplement objects, ACQ-01–03 provisions, deferred payloads and approval/selection flags remain unchanged.

These four acquisition-source questions are now settled. Their finite fulfillment consists of the named additions, matching derived representations, unchanged-field/source checks and the sixteen recorded expectation groups. No generic unchanged resubmission or further preliminary conference is needed. The later assembled exact candidate must include the resulting text and evidence for its separate review.

This closes neither 335 complete acquisitions nor resource/use validation, candidate approval, implementation, balance or whole-game flow. The reported newer partial-pass totals are not approved by this addendum.

The CRPG direction, twelve-character expedition, parallel activities and host-permission design remain carried forward; manual tabletop bookkeeping is not a completion gate. Completed scopes stay completed. Delivery remains actual final joint whole-game flow agreement → already-authorized push/commit → verified remote commit → careful cosmology review, with preservation-based cleanup in its agreed phase.
